verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party pricing page or plan documentation for Rive, so nothing shows seat types, tier structure, or which AI features (the AI agent, MCP) are gated to which plans. The only pricing signal is a community comment quoting $25/month billed annually and $39/month billed monthly. That anecdote does not show published plan clarity covering seats, tiers, or AI gating.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement
